title: QUIZ - 49
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Identify which candidate value correctly solves a given linear equation
questions.question: Which value of a satisfies \( 5a - 1 = -6 \)?
questions.explanation: Substituting a = -1 gives 5(-1) + -1 = -6, which matches the right-hand side, confirming it is the solution.
questions.hint: Try substituting each candidate value, or solve the equation directly using inverse operations.

questions.learningObjective: Verify whether a given value satisfies a linear equation by substitution
questions.question: Is t = 6 a solution to \( 8t + 7 = 23 \)?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a solution only if the equation is rearranged first.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, it is a solution.

options.label: C
options.text: No, it is not a solution.

options.label: D
options.text: There is not enough information to determine this.

questions.explanation: Substituting t = 6: 8(6) + 7 = 55. Since \(55 \neq 23\), it is not a solution.
questions.hint: Substitute the candidate value into the original equation and check whether both sides are equal.
